agent_explanation: High horizontal speed 38.9 m/s with dt=0.0157 causes body to cross arena boundary between steps 21 and 22. Despite 21 substeps (~0.029m per substep), no rebound impulse is applied at x=20-r, so centre moves from 18.95 inside to 19.565 outside overshoot 0.389 >0.15. Reducing dt to 0.001 eliminates violation, proving boundary handling fails at coarser dt.
